_comment: Curated vocabulary for the Prompt Enrichment axes. Every value was verified against the Danbooru tags API on 2026-08-30: it exists, is tag category 0 (general), and clears a 1000-post floor, so the checkpoints this app targets (ANIMA / Illustrious) actually learned it. See docs/plans/2026-08-30-prompt-enrichment-character-identity.md §19. Regenerate counts before trusting them after a long gap.

_rules.sceneIndependent: Only axes marked sceneIndependent:true are safe to inject ambiently. They describe how the image is captured, not what is in it, so they cannot contradict the post's own tags.
_rules.emptySlotOnly: An axis only fires when the prompt has NO value in that axis. The post's own tags always win: the booru annotation is the source of truth.
_rules.mutuallyExclusive: Within an axis, at most one value applies. `full_body` and `close-up` cannot both be true.
_rules.budget: Each enabled axis contributes at most 1 tag, so N enabled axes add at most N tags. Keeps prompt dilution bounded and predictable.

framing.label: Framing
framing.description: How much of the subject is in shot. Independent of scene content.

angle.label: Camera angle
angle.description: Where the camera sits relative to the subject. Independent of scene content.

optics.label: Optics
optics.description: Lens and film character. Independent of scene content.

color.label: Colour treatment
color.description: Whole-image palette. Independent of scene content but a strong aesthetic choice, so off by default.

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.description: NOT scene-independent, so it cannot be injected ambiently from a flat pool. `moonlight` contradicts a daytime post and `dappled sunlight` contradicts a night scene, which is exactly why the 297 presets in detailed-backgrounds.json bundle lighting WITH a location and a time: the preset pre-authors a coherent combination. Enabling this axis standalone requires conditioning on the post's own time and setting tags. Vocabulary is verified and split by dependency so a future implementation has the groundwork.

unconditional.description: Light quality and effects that hold in any scene.

requiresDaylight.description: Imply the sun. Contradict a night or windowless-interior post.

requiresNight.description: Imply darkness. Contradict a daytime post.

sceneObjects.description: Rejected for this axis: these are light SOURCES or events present in the scene, not lighting treatment. They belong to scenery, and detailed-backgrounds.json already places them coherently.

_rejected._comment: Verified as valid Danbooru tags but deliberately excluded, so a future edit does not re-add them without knowing why.

subjectGaze.reason: Describe where the subject looks, not where the camera is. Would fight the post's own gaze tags.

accidentalCrop.reason: Describe unintended framing artifacts rather than a deliberate choice.

wholeImageOverride.reason: monochrome (848,965) greyscales the entire image. Far too strong for an ambient toggle and it destroys every colour tag in the prompt.

compositionMode.reason: pov (199,013) restructures the whole composition and implies a first-person subject relationship. Too strong to apply ambiently.

nonexistent.reason: post_count 0 on Danbooru, so never learned by the target checkpoints.
